Package wellen

Interface MidiInListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
BeatMIDI, EventReceiverMIDI
public interface MidiInListener
interface for listeners of MidiIn.

all methods have empty default implementations, so a listener only needs to implement the methods it is interested in. methods are called on the MIDI thread, not on the processing animation thread.

since v0.14 methods use snake_case names ( e.g receive_note_on(int, int, int) ). the older camelCase methods ( e.g receiveNoteOn(int, int, int) ) are deprecated but still called: the default implementation of each new method forwards to its old counterpart.
